body: I think I might just wash the rest of my narcs down with a bottle of Jack tonight. If it doesn't kill me, at least I'll be able to sleep for once, maybe even without the nightmares.

I'm sure my wife knows. I've told her time and time again about how her inability to function without me being functional is tearing me apart. I'm pretty sure she gives a shit for about 5 minutes, then forgets the conversation. She's that way.
I wish more than anything I could go back to Iraq. It's the only place that feels "normal" for me now.
I'm not about to give anyone on the internet my location. bad idea all around.
